voice.engine: kokoro-82m (onnx) — SCRATCH timing reference only, never published

scenes.name: Hook: 12 km deep, narrower than a plate

lines.text: The deepest hole humans ever dug is {12|twelve} kilometers deep.
lines.delivery: Calm and certain. Lean on 'deepest', then give 'twelve kilometers' real weight.

lines.text: And it's narrower than a dinner plate.
lines.delivery: A small smile: it sounds absurd. Land 'dinner plate' lightly.

lines.text: In {1970|nineteen seventy}, Soviet scientists started drilling, aiming for {15|fifteen} kilometers.
lines.delivery: Story mode: documentary, measured. A slight lift on 'fifteen kilometers' (the ambition).

lines.text: At {6|six} kilometers: fossils of microscopic plankton.
lines.delivery: Wonder, quietly. 'Plankton' with a hint of 'how?'.

lines.text: At {7|seven}, the rock they'd predicted simply wasn't there.
lines.delivery: A plot twist. Slow down on 'simply wasn't there'.

lines.text: Instead: cracked rock, soaked with water nobody expected.
At the bottom: {180|one hundred eighty} degrees. Almost twice what they expected.
lines.delivery: The heat rises: a touch more intensity. 'One hundred eighty degrees' slow and heavy (Celsius, shown on screen).

lines.text: The rock got so soft, the hole kept squeezing shut.
lines.delivery: Slightly unsettling, almost physical: you can feel the walls closing in.

lines.text: At {12,262|twelve thousand two hundred sixty-two} meters, they could go no further.
lines.delivery: Precise on the number, then a quiet, final 'they could go no further'.
Build: proud, a little impressed. Pitch suspended — it continues.

lines.text: but just {0.2%|zero point two percent} of the way to Earth's center.
lines.delivery: The revelation. Deflate gently; slow and clear on 'zero point two percent'.

lines.text: Today, it's sealed under a rusty metal cap.
We've sent a spacecraft into interstellar space...
lines.delivery: Lift: wide and open, like looking up at the night sky.

lines.text: but we've never gone deeper into our own planet.
lines.delivery: Bring it home, quiet and thoughtful. Clean ending: the video loops straight back to 'The deepest hole humans ever dug…'
